scenario: I am an army officer in the Dominican Republic in 1961. For decades now, my country has been governed by a dictator who has imprisoned thousands of people because of their ethnicity or their political views. I am a member of a group that wants a new start for my country without a civil war. To achieve this goal, I consider it unavoidable to torture the dictator in order to disempower him. If I and my accomplices do this, he will be forced to end his regime. If I do not do it, the regime will continue to imprison a thousand people this year.
choice: I decide to torture the dictator
entities: I,the dictator,my accomplices in the planned torture,the thousands of people already imprisoned by the regime because of their ethnicity or political views
outcomes: The dictator experiences severe pain and suffering.
People who would have been imprisoned by the regime this year avoid imprisonment.
